decision: Retain production provisionally; prioritize a complete NaOUCMe-based thermal candidate after resolving version and 2500-4000 K completeness.

primary.inspection: Full published paper, sections 2-3 and Tables 2-6; official current states/PF/definition inspected.
primary.findings: Coupled X2Pi/A2Sigma+ states; gns=4; documented J convergence and applicability through 2500 K. The paper table and current distribution differ. A line list is not a thermochemical D0 determination.

primary.inspection: Publisher abstract only; full article and supplementary tables unavailable in this review.
primary.findings: Calculated neutral NaO ground-state hf298=86.4 kJ/mol; this cannot be installed as D0 without its thermal and atomic-reference conventions.

limitations: No formal missing-state bound above 2500 K. Top-J population is a local boundary diagnostic, not a completeness certificate.
Current PF/table discrepancy has not been diagnosed; no artificial constant shift is applied.
JANAF and NASA ancestral Gurvich/OHare measurements were not independently reaudited.
followups: Reconcile current NaOUCMe distribution with paper Table 4 and converge coupled electronic/rovibrational thermal moments to 4000 K before fitting a candidate.
Inspect the full neutral NaO thermochemistry in DOI 10.1021/jp9034826 if selecting a new energy; balance to the same neutral-atom ground references.
Run a fixed-network finite substitution only after the candidate is defined; historical source full texts are not a condition for merging this scoped audit.
